requirements.description: Discovery and assessment phase: Review up to twenty (20) Bank documents, including workforce data, HR reports, planning documents, and organizational information; review workforce datasets including demographics, movement trends, vacancies, retirement eligibility, workforce planning metrics; conduct fifteen (15) stakeholder interviews of sixty (60) minutes each; conduct one (1) three-hour stakeholder validation session; assess current workforce planning practices, risks, and challenges; identify current and future workforce capability requirements; develop a workforce planning assessment summarizing key findings, risks, opportunities, and observations.

source_refs.excerpt: Review up to twenty (20) Bank documents, including workforce data, HR reports, planning documents, and organizational information; Review workforce datasets, including demographics, movement trends, vacancies, retirement eligibility, workforce planning metrics, and related indicators; Conduct fifteen (15) stakeholder interviews of sixty (60) minutes each with HR and senior business leaders on workforce priorities, risks, succession, talent needs, and future capabilities; Conduct one (1) three-hour stakeholder validation session to review findings, validate observations, and discuss priority workforce planning considerations; Assess current workforce planning practices, workforce risks, and workforce-related challenges; Identify current and future workforce capability requirements; and Develop a workforce planning assessment summarizing key findings, risks, opportunities, and observations.
